items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: Yeah, I met him once and he was a great guy to know.

ctx.x: Yeah. You could almost tell what kind of person Cannonball was from the way he played.

Yeah. Freewheeling — I met him one time and he loved barbecue and it seemed like that as long as he could get something to eat he’s all right with playing the horn. Yeah, I met him once and he was a great guy to know.
